name: ai-for-academic-writing
description: An author-first workflow for planning, writing, reviewing, managing experiments, and plotting results for top-conference papers.

interface.shortDescription: Author-first workflows for rigorous ML papers.
interface.longDescription: Plan and write insight-driven papers, process GitHub author review, manage formal experiment ledgers, and produce reproducible publication figures.
defaultPrompt: Shape my evidence into an insightful paper story.
Process author feedback on this paper PR.
Audit my paper experiments and figures.
